scope: read-only HBJC model decoding and Pk table retrieval

report_visible_context: 短路阻抗和负载损耗测量
inputs.naming_rule: JB/T 3837-2024 变压器类产品型号编制方法

decoded_summary.generated_table_target: 三相油浸式电力变压器，额定容量400 kVA，高压侧电压10 kV，无励磁调压，铜导线，立体卷铁芯，损耗水平代号20，能效等级2级，标准参数表

issues: The full description added default features such as 105-class insulation, self-cooling, double windings, copper conductor, and electrical-steel core without one evidence item per feature.
The evidence quote for 400/10 referenced the NX energy-grade paragraph instead of the model composition rule.
The loss-code explanation included relative loss-reduction percentages that are unnecessary for identity-only decoding and risk leaking normative performance information into retrieval context.

retrieval.interpretation: The model-generated table query is useful, but equal RRF across all routes can demote a strong specialized route when noisy candidates recur across more routes.

conclusion: The naming-rule document provides real retrieval value without manually authoring the target query. Before product integration, tighten the decoding prompt to require evidence per derived feature and keep performance rules out of identity decoding, then define a fusion policy that preserves strong table_target results.
